glow.note: the bulb: light it when a flashlight hits (recoil); dead = default colour

props.receipt: HandR_Receipt: show only during SlideReceipt (hide at events.SlideReceipt.release)

sit.note: place the pivot on the floor at the booth seat centre, facing the counter

counter.note: PlaceReceipt and Vault assume the counter's near edge 1.1 studs in front of the pivot

props.receipt: HandR_Receipt: show from events.PlaceReceipt.show to events.PlaceReceipt.release
props.bag_corner: BagCorner: tint with the bag; hide from events.TearBag.hideCorner for the rest of the visit

placement.note: pivot CFrame.new(0, 0, -55.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) (faces +Z): the front wall's centre plane is 15.5 studs in front of the pivot; eyes in the picture window's lower pane, palms on the M7 glass and the transom glass over the door

props.receipt: HandR_Receipt (THE BIG ONE): show during HandSlam until events.HandSlam.slam, then hide and spawn the real receipt at slamPoint

meta.hangNote: pivot = hang point (toe grip, top); the body hangs ~9.5 studs below it; built for a 12-stud ceiling

crawl.note: pivot stays on the ceiling plane; body centred under the pivot
